svg.title: Helium balloon with a highlight, knot and curling ribbon.
svg.desc: Filled party balloon: elliptical body, a paper-tone highlight on the upper left, a triangular knot, and a curling string. Reach for birthdays, grand openings, kids' events, congratulations. Not a hot-air balloon (hot-air-balloon) and not a cluster (balloon-bunch). Body accent, highlight paper, knot accent2, string ink.
